prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent game ultimate-skill icon, square, designed to remain crisp and immediately legible at 48x48 pixels in a compact action-game HUD. Primary request: Resonant Dome for Gu Pin, an original salvage-world signal technician. One unified bold triangular-dome silhouette: exactly three small sturdy peacock-teal mineral-crystal capacitor nodes, one foreground center and two farther left and right, connect by three simple luminous cyan arcs to support a single transparent teal hemispherical energy dome above them. Each node has a chunky aged-ivory ceramic pedestal and minimal warm copper rim. The dome is the dominant focal shape, its crown and curved perimeter bright, translucent interior quiet and simple; subtle broad glassy teal planes, no dense mesh. Show a three-quarter view, compact harmonious composition that reads instantly as a field generated by three devices. Premium hand-painted stylized industrial fantasy, clear solid device edges, high local contrast, controlled highlights, original machinery. Palette aged ivory #D2D1BB, peacock teal #3E8D8D with restrained bright cyan energy, dark umber #4B443D and warm copper accents. Full dome and all three nodes contained inside generous 12% safe margins. No little sparks, no additional nodes, no ground disk, no shield or barrier emblem. Truly transparent alpha background, isolated object and energy effect. No environment, floor, background color, ground shadow, frame, border, circular UI badge, text, numbers, letters, logos or watermark. No character, no magic runes, no ornate filigree, no recognizable existing game symbol. Do not add a square panel behind the icon.
